history.summary: The eye-catching $1176 PSF is a mirage: this is a 3401 sqft oversized unit (penthouse/strata or dual-key type) at a $4.0M absolute quantum in D19. Cheap PSF on a huge freehold unit does not translate to a liquid or appreciating investment — the $4M ticket sits in an extremely thin buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Classic oversized-unit-as-cheap-PSF trap. $1176 PSF looks cheap only because the unit is 3401 sqft; the $4.0M absolute price is far above the liquid sweet spot, in an OCR D19 location 1.1km from Serangoon MRT — a combination with a very shallow resale market. No URA data, freehold but huge and niche. Investment fundamentals (liquidity, yield on $4M, exit) are poor; this is an own-stay/lifestyle unit, not an investment buy.
red_flags: Oversized 3401 sqft unit — low PSF masks a $4.0M absolute quantum in OCR D19
$4M is deep in the thin-buyer-pool zone; exit liquidity is severely limited
1.1km / 13 min to Serangoon MRT — no station premium
No URA data; large bespoke units have very few comparables to price against
catalysts: Freehold tenure and a 2018 build preserve long-run value
Generous space appeals to a niche large-family/multi-gen own-stay buyer (not investors)
